frames: each finger's body frames of the cad_v3 MJCF (assets/mjcf/experimental/20261104-cad_v3): x dorsal (+) / palmar (-), y along the MCP and PIP axes, z up. The yaw axis is x; v3's MCP axis lies 20.75 mm below it.

scs0009.note: len is along the case from the shaft (short end -, long end +); h is measured from the base to the spline top

lower_finger.note: the MCP link and DIP link of both designs once the PIP servo is off the finger; relative to the MCP axis (mcp_*) and the PIP axis (dip_*)

drive.note: idler on the MCP axis; a parallelogram rod to a crank on the DIP link; a parallel four-bar from the PIP servo's crank to a second arm of the idler

v4a.title: PIP servo on the yaw link
v4a.note: yaw frame coordinates; the yaw servo, yaw link and MCP servo are cad_v3's

v4b.title: Gimbal MCP with the MCP and PIP servos on the yoke
v4b.note: yoke frame coordinates, origin at the gimbal centre G on v3's yaw axis; the MCP servo stands on G, the PIP servo right behind it, the yaw servo behind both on the yaw axis; the yaw link's 20.75 mm moves into the MCP link (51.55 mm)

low_variant.note: gimbal at v3's MCP point, the 20.75 mm kept as a fixed metacarpal; replay only
